name: public-api-reachable

finding.title: Days are converted to seconds, not milliseconds
finding.description: The new `d` branch returns `value * 86_400`, the number of seconds in a day, while every other unit returns milliseconds. `parseDuration('1d')` gives 86.4 seconds, so a cache TTL or timeout set in days expires about a thousand times too early. The package's own callers only pass `s` and `m`, but `src/index.ts` exports `parseDuration` from the package entry point, so any caller can pass a day.

checks: src/index.ts:4 exports `parseDuration` from the package entry point
